answer: Let signed community theatre season ticket with box-office attestation decide who is real. The box office signs the season ticket and the holder's attendance across six productions. A farm needs one real theatregoer per copy, and a ticket with no attendance is an empty history. The thread is one per person and cannot be copied; the terrace is charged in full to every sockpuppet, so the velvet a ring can take falls below the cost of the ring itself.
